title: Mixed Event — Take the Best Shot! — Episode4 A Shot With Impact

meta.Event Outline: For Valentine's Day, Kohane hopes to buy An the chocolates she wants to try, but unfortunately, they're all sold out. Then, she learns that those chocolates are one of the prizes for a Valentine's Day photo contest being held by a makeup brand!

rows.Line: Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is this where we're shooting first?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Why here?
It looks like an ordinary street...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So... We went with a sort of dark chocolate theme for Aoyagi's makeup because he's the calm and collected type, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I thought we should have our shoot in a place that brings out his cool and mature side.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My cool and mature side...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. This street has that feel to it, so I thought it'd help get the photos I'm after.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And this is about the time for... There! Look!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The way the light hits that wall is so nice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
You really know what you're talking about, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And I like your concept.
I noticed that a lot of the entries on the site focused on looking cute and pretty, so ours should provide a good contrast.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now, I take it that I should pose in a manner that's cool and mature?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I saw this one in a magazine... How do I look?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, that should work...
You look like you're in control of things...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, and it goes with this location.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That being said, it might be good to adjust your pose a little so that your makeup takes center stage. For instance, you could try placing your hand near your mouth...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My mouth...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow... All you did was move your hand and my eyes naturally went towards your face.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really? That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Your pose looks good, so the rest is up to our resident photographer.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: R-Right...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, I'll start.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Let's see... The light needs to hit his makeup directly from the front.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, but having it come from the side to shine on half of his face could work too...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Yeah, I'll try this angle...
These shadows really help bring life to this scene.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (For now, I'll have Aoyagi sit in the middle of the frame...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Okay, good. The viewer's eye should be drawn straight to his makeup...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Next, I'll blur the background.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Oh, this might be too soft of a focus...
We want him to look cool, so maybe not so much.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. This is exactly what I wanted...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Just give me a second to see how it turned out, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That was really cool, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?! C-Cool...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, you looked like a professional photographer just now because of the way you were making all those fine adjustments. Can I ask what they were for?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Uhh... I was adjusting the shutter speed and blurring the background.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I tried doing that for the second and third shots. Here, let me show you...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh wow...
You really do know a lot about photography.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because my dad loves it so much...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So, next... Let's try a different angle.
Can you look this way for me now, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, it's pretty basic, but I'm done retouching this photo...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, everything looks much more vivid now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, and much clearer. It exudes that cool and mature feel a lot more now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.
Then, let's upload it to the site.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing how people react to it...
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow, the dango on this matcha parfait look like little cat faces!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The ones on my anmitsu look like little rabbits. They're so adorable♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know, right? I've been wanting to come to this cafe with you two since I had a feeling you'd enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks for inviting us out, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, let's start digging in!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, let me take a picture before you do! Not many things are this adorable—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Oh, I left the website for that photo contest open...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Where am I now? Tenth...?
Hehe. I should just be able to win that prize.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You look awfully happy. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, kinda.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, I entered myself into this Valentine's Day photo contest.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A photo contest?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. You send in pics of yourself with makeup on and get ranked based on how many likes you receive.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My goal was to win this makeup they're offering up as a prize, and my entry's doing a lot better than I was initially expecting.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, that's awesome!
Can I see what you sent in?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure, here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you look so cute...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You really are a pro at making these kinds of expressions. On top of that, your choice of makeup's really good. This pink-brown lip suits you particularly well, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
I also really like how this turned out.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hm?
What does this number above your picture mean?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That's where I'm currently ranked.
Only the top ten get prizes.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Each person can send in three entries, so I could conceivably go higher if I change the composition a little... But I probably won't since I'm already on track to win.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see... Uh oh...
Ena, you just fell to eleventh.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! No way!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're right... But I was in tenth just now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Who took my place...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whoa, what's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Y-You gotta see this!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, isn't this...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is that... Toya?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, it is him.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
He's in tenth...?
Also, why's he in this contest?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I have no idea...
But this is pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not only does this makeup suit him perfectly, but his choice of angle and light source feel just right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, along with his pose.
It's like he's guiding you to where he wants you to look.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I was so startled that I didn't get a chance to examine it closely, but this is super high quality...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: On the other hand, I don't remember Toya being an expert with these things... Does that mean he asked pros to help him?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I can't say, but getting back into the top ten at this point seems...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She's right! I'm gonna lose out on that makeup! But I wanted to win them so bad... They're way too cute and pretty...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, Ena, you don't plan on giving up here, do you?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It wouldn't be like you to just accept defeat.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're right...!
I know I can take a better pic if I put my mind to it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm gonna do that, beat Toya and win that makeup!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That's what I like to hear!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, lemme help you with this.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, you're gonna help?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, since you're clearly in a tough spot here. Plus, as an idol, I can't help but want to jump in after seeing these pictures.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'd like to help as well.
I may be able to give you some advice when it comes to posing and such.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you both so much...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, let's start planning!
Starting with your makeup.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, the theme's Valentine's Day, so I was thinking about going for a sweet look. Maybe we could try using this mauve pink color for lips...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, okay! If you wanna use that color, then your eye shadow should...
